verdict: Targeted corrections pass within a cooperative local boundary: transactional append-only snapshots and durable pre-effect creation claims remove the demonstrated invisible creation orphan. No exactly-once, hostile-filesystem or production lifecycle guarantee.
fixes: Whole-projection snapshots append in the same transaction as successful logical changes; prior states/outcomes remain inspectable after reopen.
Hash/parent/sequence and latest projection consistency are validated; API has no history update/delete methods; SQL guards reject update/delete/replacement on the candidate connection.
Creation intent persists unique identity/path/digest/size, alias and cleanup obligation before external creation; physical receipt follows observation.
Absent intent can be explicitly replayed with matching supplied bytes; matching present file can be reconciled without rewriting it.
Mutated or unsafe files are sticky quarantined, preserved, and keep cleanup prerequisites pinned.
Effect-boundary revalidation prevents a delayed cooperating dispatcher from recreating an identity already completed and disposed.
surviving_counterexample: An identical-byte different-inode replacement before the first physical receipt is accepted; the original unreceipted inode is unknowable from the intent. A moved old file remains. Unique capability ownership and cooperative writers are assumed.
compatibility: Existing create_file/resource/retention/ticket call shapes retained. Version is journal-v2; v1 databases explicitly rejected without implicit migration. Pending managed resources have null dev/ino and cannot be operationally acquired or disposed until receipt.
limitations: Direct privileged database tampering, dropped guards, whole-chain rewrite and file replacement are outside the trust boundary; no external signed history anchor.
Complete registered membership/dependencies and cooperative publishers/deployments remain assumptions.
Full snapshots and whole-chain validation are deliberately unscalable; management history is not a research retention root.
Quarantine has no automatic repair/cancel path; coarse tickets block unrelated creation/reconciliation and have no expiry.
Provider adoption and cleanup executables remain asserted, not executed by the journal.
Gate must independently bind plan bytes, backend/configuration receipts and physical identity mapping.
No native DML/LMDB, power-loss, universal provider adoption, secure erasure or legal-compliance claim.
next_experiment: Independent v2 rerun, then fresh-owned integration with the saved-plan gate and import-capable synthetic artifact provider using immutable receipt observations.
